integritetspolicy.title: Privacy policy
integritetspolicy.description: How WIGOSE AB processes personal data when you use rcsdirekt.se and rcsdirekt.se.

sections.heading: Who is responsible
sections.body:
WIGOSE AB (org. no. 559415-6753), Klostergatan 15, 703 39 Örebro, operates rcsdirekt.se and is the controller of the personal data processing described here.

Send questions about your data to info@rcsdirekt.se, through the contact form on rcsdirekt.se, or by post to the address above.

sections.heading: What data we collect
sections.body:
When you submit the contact form, request an account or sign up for a webinar, we save what you enter: name and email, and company, phone number and message if you provide them. For a webinar registration we also save which webinar it concerns.

When you upload a video in the video generator, we save the video and the time of the upload together with a hash of your IP address. The hash is a code calculated from the address. We do not save the IP address itself.

Our servers log technical data about each request, such as time and IP address. When a form is received, the email address is also logged.

sections.heading: Why we process the data
sections.body:
- Contact form: to answer your question. The legal basis is our legitimate interest in being able to respond to those who get in touch (Article 6.1(f) of the EU General Data Protection Regulation, GDPR).
- Account request: to activate the account and agree on the terms. The processing is necessary before a contract is entered into (Article 6.1(b)).
- Webinar registration: to send the link and run the webinar. The basis is our legitimate interest (Article 6.1(f)).
- Video upload: to show the video through the link and to limit how many videos the same sender can upload. The basis is our legitimate interest in preventing abuse (Article 6.1(f)).
- Server logs: for operation and security. The basis is our legitimate interest (Article 6.1(f)).

We make no automated decisions about you and do not sell your data.

sections.heading: How long we keep the data
sections.body:
- Contact requests and account requests that do not lead to a contract: 12 months after the last contact.
- Webinar registrations: 3 months after the webinar.
- Customer data: for as long as the customer relationship lasts. Accounting records are kept for 7 years under the Swedish Accounting Act (bokföringslagen).
- Uploaded videos: for as long as the link is needed. If you want a video removed, you can contact us.
- Hashed IP addresses: used only to count uploads during the past 24 hours.
- Server logs: 30 days.

sections.heading: Who receives the data
sections.body:
The data is stored with Google Cloud in the europe-west1 region, located in Belgium. Google processes it on our behalf under Google's data processing agreement for Google Cloud.

Google is a US company and may in some cases transfer data to the United States, for example for support. Such transfers are supported by the European Commission's decision on the EU-US Data Privacy Framework and by standard contractual clauses.

When we reply to you we use our email service, and for a webinar the platform the webinar is broadcast on.

sections.heading: Fonts and cookies
sections.body:
The site loads fonts from Google Fonts. Your IP address is then sent to Google when the page loads.

We do not use cookies for statistics or marketing. The browser stores locally whether you have closed the notice bar at the top, and the video generator stores what you have entered so that it is still there next time. That data stays in your browser.

sections.heading: Messages our customers send
sections.body: When a company sends RCS through us, the company is the controller of the recipients' data, and we are the processor. This is governed by a data processing agreement between us and the customer. Direct questions about a message you have received to the company that sent it.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body:
You have the right to know what data we hold about you and to get a copy of it. You can ask us to correct or erase data, to restrict the processing, or to receive the data you yourself have provided in a machine-readable format. When the processing is based on our legitimate interest, you have the right to object to it.

Contact info@rcsdirekt.se, use the contact form, or write to us by post. We respond within one month.

If you are dissatisfied with how we process your data, you can lodge a complaint with the Swedish Authority for Privacy Protection (IMY) at imy.se.

sections.heading: Changes
sections.body: We update the policy when we change how we process personal data. The date at the top shows when it was last changed.

villkor.title: Terms
villkor.description: The terms for companies that send RCS through rcsdirekt.se.

sections.heading: About the terms
sections.body:
The terms apply between WIGOSE AB (org. no. 559415-6753), which operates rcsdirekt.se, and the company that creates an account (the customer). The service is intended for companies and organizations, not for private individuals.

If the customer and rcsdirekt.se have a written agreement, it takes precedence over these terms.

sections.heading: The service
sections.body:
With rcsdirekt.se the customer sends RCS messages from a web tool or through an API. The messages are delivered through the mobile operators and Google's RCS service. If the recipient's phone or operator does not support RCS, the message cannot be delivered as RCS.

We work to keep the service running without interruption, but we cannot promise that every message will arrive.

sections.heading: Account and sender
sections.body:
The customer must provide correct information about the company. Each sender is registered and verified before it may send. The customer may only send in its own name or in the name of a company that has given the customer the right to do so.

The customer is responsible for keeping login credentials and API keys secret and for everything sent from the account.

sections.heading: Prices and payment
sections.body:
The customer pays per message sent according to the price list at rcsdirekt.se/priser or according to a price we have agreed on. Prices are stated excluding VAT. There is no setup fee, monthly fee or minimum commitment period.

How and when the customer pays is stated in the agreement or on the invoice. In case of late payment we are entitled to penalty interest under the Swedish Interest Act (räntelagen). We may change the prices with 30 days' notice.

sections.heading: Permitted use
sections.body:
The customer is responsible for the content of the messages and for ensuring that the sendouts comply with the law, in particular the Swedish Marketing Act (marknadsföringslagen) and the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). Among other things, this means that

- advertising to private individuals may only be sent to someone who has consented in advance, or to existing customers under the exception in section 19 of the Swedish Marketing Act
- each advertising message must show who is sending it and give the recipient a simple way to opt out of further sendouts
- the customer must have a legal basis for using the recipients' phone numbers.

The customer may not send messages that are misleading or unlawful, or that pose as coming from someone else. The customer must also follow the rules for RCS senders set by Google and the operators.

sections.heading: Suspension
sections.body: We may suspend an account or a sender immediately if the customer breaches the terms, if the sendouts lead to complaints, or if an operator or Google requires it. We will notify the customer as soon as we can.

sections.heading: Personal data
sections.body: When the customer sends messages, the customer is the controller of the recipients' data and WIGOSE AB is the processor. This is governed by a data processing agreement entered into before the customer starts sending. How we process data about the customer and its contact persons is described in the privacy policy.

sections.heading: Liability
sections.body: We are not liable for indirect damages, such as lost profits, or for faults caused by operators, Google, the recipient's phone or anything else outside our control. Our total liability is limited to what the customer has paid for the service during the past three months.

sections.heading: Termination
sections.body: The customer may terminate the account at any time. Messages that have already been sent are charged. We may terminate the service with 30 days' notice, or immediately if the customer materially breaches the terms.

sections.heading: Changes to the terms
sections.body: We may change the terms. We notify the customer of material changes at least 30 days before they take effect.

sections.heading: Governing law and disputes
sections.body: Swedish law governs the terms. Disputes are decided by a Swedish general court, with the Örebro District Court (Örebro tingsrätt) as the court of first instance.
